text:
elaine: Heads up — huge p95/p99 spike on hosted API for tenant tid-58 (prod-eu) starting ~22:40 UTC. p95 went from ~120ms to ~870ms, p99 from ~400ms to ~3.2s. Queue depth to redwood-l4-2 pool shot from 8 -> 120. Seeing a lot of queued requests. Anyone on call?

ravi: yup I see it in grafana. Continuous batching backlog combined with elevated GPU wait. KV cache hit-rate plunged to 12% (normal ~78%).

jon: did the kernel selector flip for that model in last night’s rollout? We had a kernel-heuristics tweak landed yesterday.

perf-bot: alert: kernel-chooser rolled out v2.3 to prod-eu pools at 21:15 UTC (change: sampler threshold adjustment).

 sachin: can we get a profiler trace + top of batcher during the spike? quick command: ```curl -sS http://perf-agent.local/profiler?since=70s | pbzip2 -d > trace.pb``` then `./tools/trace-summary trace.pb`

elaine: pasted short flame output from the trace-summary: `kv_cache::evict -> batcher::enqueue -> kernel::fallback -> gpu_wait` — lots of evictions leading into fallback kernels.

ravi: that matches the hit-rate drop. My hypothesis: new kernel paths increased per-request latency variance which caused prefix mismatches and more KV evictions (thrash). Thrashed KV -> lower hit-rate -> more work -> longer kernels -> backpressure -> queues.

jon: temporary mitigation: pin tenant tid-58 to eu-fallback-k22 (kernel v2.2) and increase per-shard kv reserve. @deploy-bot can you pin routing for tenant?

deploy-bot: @jon started routing-change job: `route.pin tenant=tid-58 pool=eu-fallback-k22 --dry-run` 
Job queued id=3421

sachin: did a quick probe on a staging node by bumping cache reserve +20% — hit-rate rose to ~65% and p95 dropped back to ~140ms in the probe. Suggest increase cache and rollback kernel-chooser to v2.2 for prod-eu while we debug.

elaine: plan proposed: 1) pin tenant to eu-fallback-k22 (manual) 2) rollback kernel-chooser v2.3 -> v2.2 in prod-eu 3) increase per-shard kv cache reserve by 20% 4) run perf regression matrix (kernel x batcher x seq_len) and add synthetic guard.

ravi: I'll open an incident ticket NETPERF-213 and add a nightly repro using the same request mix that triggered the spike. Also adding alert: kv_hit_rate < 50% for >2m triggers pager.

jon: applying the route pin now (non-dry-run).

deploy-bot: Routing change applied: route.pin job 3421 -> completed at 22:51:03 UTC

perf-bot: metric update: post-mitigation p95=130ms, p99=320ms, queue depth ~10. KV hit-rate back to ~70%.

elaine: great. Follow-ups: 1) reproduce locally (jon+sachin) and capture full flamegraphs, 2) add unit/integration test for prefetch race condition, 3) make kernel selection telemetry more granular (emit chosen kernel + sampler decision per request), 4) add alerting for sudden KV hit-rate drops. :thumbsup:

ravi: ack — I'll own NETPERF-213 and the alert. jon/sachin pair on repro + test. We'll also gate the next kernel-chooser rollout behind the regression suite. :thinking_face:
